Based on the extracted SHAP information and the subsequent suggested strategies, the final recommended strategies to effectively optimize healthcare costs include:

1. Hospital Service Area: Transfer patients to lower-cost service areas within the hospital network when clinically appropriate.
2. Hospital County: Explore partnerships or resource sharing with hospitals in lower-cost counties to optimize expenditures.
3. Facility Name: Evaluate and improve operational efficiencies at Long Island Community Hospital by adopting best practices from lower-cost facilities.
4. Age Group: Implement targeted preventive care programs for specific age groups to reduce complications and costs.
5. Zip Code - 3 digits: Increase telehealth and outpatient services usage to reduce inpatient admissions and costs.
6. Race: Provide culturally tailored health education and intervention programs to address health disparities.
7. Length of Stay: Enhance discharge planning, early mobilization, and care coordination to safely reduce length of stay.
8. Type of Admission: Promote scheduled (elective) admissions over urgent/emergent admissions for better resource management.
9. Patient Disposition: Enhance post-discharge care coordination and support to reduce readmissions.
10. CCSR Diagnosis and Procedure Codes: Use evidence-based clinical pathways and optimize procedure selection to reduce unnecessary treatments and costs.
11. APR DRG and Severity of Illness: Focus on clinical management improvements and early intervention programs to reduce complications and severity.
12. APR Medical Surgical Description: Standardize surgical protocols and enhance perioperative efficiency.
13. Payment Typology 1: Negotiate payment terms and promote value-based payment models.
14. Emergency Department Indicator: Develop alternative care pathways and improve primary care access to reduce non-emergent ED visits.
15. Total Charges: Regularly review and optimize charge capture and billing processes for accuracy and cost-saving opportunities.

Applying these strategies can significantly reduce healthcare costs while maintaining or improving patient care quality.
